title: Ines and the Room
author: Ines Whitlock
blurb: Gideon Delacroix, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
